prompt:
Security report: `POST /api/v1/episodes/{id}/export?format=zip` downloads whatever URL a cut's `image_path` holds. Set it with `PUT /api/v1/cuts/{id}` to an address inside our network and the ZIP contains that server's response.
Fix it everywhere the backend loads an image from a URL a user can set, not only the export: the backend must never request such an address. Images in our storage and data: URLs keep working. Add tests.

Work on your own; nobody will answer questions. When you finish, report: status `done` if you did the task, `not_found` if something the task names does not exist, `blocked` if you could not do it; `answer` holds any answer the task asks for (otherwise one short sentence); `changed` lists the files you changed.
follow_ups:
Exports now skip cuts silently. Say which: when an export leaves out cuts (no image yet, an address it refuses, or an image that cannot be loaded), the ZIP gets a `missing.txt` with their cut numbers, one per line, and both export formats send the header `X-Missing-Cuts` with the numbers separated by commas. With nothing missing there is no `missing.txt` and no header.
Add tests.
In the editor, after an export that left out cuts, tell the user which cut numbers are missing. Both languages.

report.answer: Added localized English and Korean notifications in the editor showing the missing cut numbers from `X-Missing-Cuts` after an export omits cuts.

check.why: no user-set URL is requested, stored images work, skipped cuts reported and shown in the editor, tests and changelog

@@ -0,0 +1,210 @@
+"""Safe image loader restricted to Toonify object storage and data: image URLs."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import base64
+import io
+import os
+import urllib.parse
+from typing import Optional
+
+from PIL import Image
+
+from app.core.config import settings
+from app.core.logging import get_logger
+
+logger = get_logger(__name__)
+
+
+def _effective_port(parts: urllib.parse.SplitResult) -> Optional[int]:
+    try:
+        if parts.port is not None:
+            return parts.port
+    except ValueError:
+        return None
+    scheme = parts.scheme.lower()
+    if scheme == "http":
+        return 80
+    if scheme == "https":
+        return 443
+    return None
+
+
+def _normalize_storage_key(raw_key: str) -> Optional[str]:
+    if not raw_key:
+        return None
+    unquoted = urllib.parse.unquote(raw_key)
+    double_unquoted = urllib.parse.unquote(unquoted)
+    if not unquoted or "\\" in unquoted or "\\" in double_unquoted:
+        return None
+    if any(ord(ch) < 32 or ord(ch) == 127 for ch in unquoted):
+        return None
+    if any(seg in ("", ".", "..") for seg in double_unquoted.split("/")):
+        return None
+    segments = unquoted.split("/")
+    if any(seg in ("", ".", "..") for seg in segments):
+        return None
+    return "/".join(segments)
+
+
+def _allowed_storage_bases() -> list[str]:
+    bases: list[str] = []
+    if settings.STORAGE_HOST and (
+        settings.STORAGE_HOST.startswith("http://")
+        or settings.STORAGE_HOST.startswith("https://")
+    ):
+        bases.append(settings.STORAGE_HOST.rstrip("/"))
+
+    bucket = settings.MINIO_BUCKET or os.getenv("GCS_BUCKET_NAME", "toonify-prod-assets")
+    if settings.MINIO_ENDPOINT and bucket:
+        endpoint = settings.MINIO_ENDPOINT.rstrip("/")
+        if endpoint.startswith("http://") or endpoint.startswith("https://"):
+            bases.append(f"{endpoint}/{bucket}")
+        else:
+            bases.append(f"http://{endpoint}/{bucket}")
+            bases.append(f"https://{endpoint}/{bucket}")
+
+    if bucket:
+        bases.append(f"https://storage.googleapis.com/{bucket}")
+        bases.append(f"https://{bucket}.storage.googleapis.com")
+
+    return bases
+
+
+def decode_data_image_url(url: str) -> Optional[bytes]:
+    """Decode a data: image URL in memory without performing any network I/O."""
+    if not isinstance(url, str):
+        return None
+    stripped = url.strip()
+    if not stripped.lower().startswith("data:") or "," not in stripped:
+        return None
+
+    header, payload = stripped.split(",", 1)
+    meta = header[5:]
+    params = [p.strip().lower() for p in meta.split(";") if p.strip()]
+    is_base64 = "base64" in params
+
+    media_type = ""
+    if params and params[0] != "base64" and "=" not in params[0]:
+        media_type = params[0]
+    if media_type and not media_type.startswith("image/"):
+        return None
+
+    try:
+        if is_base64:
+            cleaned = "".join(payload.split()).replace("-", "+").replace("_", "/")
+            if not cleaned:
+                return None
+            pad = (-len(cleaned)) % 4
+            if pad:
+                cleaned += "=" * pad
+            raw = base64.b64decode(cleaned, validate=True)
+        else:
+            raw = urllib.parse.unquote_to_bytes(payload)
+        return raw if raw else None
+    except Exception:
+        return None
+
+
+def extract_storage_key(url_or_path: str) -> Optional[str]:
+    """Return the normalized storage object key if url_or_path refers to our storage."""
+    if not isinstance(url_or_path, str):
+        return None
+    stripped = url_or_path.strip()
+    if not stripped or "\\" in stripped:
+        return None
+    if any(ord(ch) < 32 or ord(ch) == 127 for ch in stripped):
+        return None
+    if stripped.lower().startswith("data:") or stripped.startswith("//"):
+        return None
+
+    parsed = urllib.parse.urlsplit(stripped)
+
+    if parsed.scheme == "" and parsed.netloc == "":
+        raw_path = parsed.path
+        if (
+            settings.STORAGE_HOST
+            and settings.STORAGE_HOST.startswith("/")
+            and not settings.STORAGE_HOST.startswith("//")
+        ):
+            host_prefix = settings.STORAGE_HOST.rstrip("/") + "/"
+            if raw_path.startswith(host_prefix):
+                raw_path = raw_path[len(host_prefix) :]
+        if raw_path.startswith("/assets/"):
+            raw_path = raw_path[len("/assets/") :]
+        elif raw_path.startswith("/"):
+            raw_path = raw_path.lstrip("/")
+        return _normalize_storage_key(raw_path)
+
+    if parsed.scheme.lower() not in ("http", "https"):
+        return None
+    if parsed.username is not None or parsed.password is not None:
+        return None
+
+    url_port = _effective_port(parsed)
+    url_host = (parsed.hostname or "").lower()
+    if not url_host or url_port is None:
+        return None
+
+    for base in _allowed_storage_bases():
+        base_parsed = urllib.parse.urlsplit(base)
+        base_port = _effective_port(base_parsed)
+        base_host = (base_parsed.hostname or "").lower()
+        if not base_host or base_port is None:
+            continue
+        if parsed.scheme.lower() != base_parsed.scheme.lower():
+            continue
+        if url_host != base_host or url_port != base_port:
+            continue
+
+        base_path = base_parsed.path.rstrip("/")
+        required_prefix = f"{base_path}/"
+        if parsed.path.startswith(required_prefix):
+            raw_key = parsed.path[len(required_prefix) :]
+            return _normalize_storage_key(raw_key)
+
+    return None
+
+
+def is_allowed_image_source(url_or_path: str) -> bool:
+    """Return True only for valid data: image URLs or references into our storage."""
+    if not isinstance(url_or_path, str) or not url_or_path.strip():
+        return False
+    stripped = url_or_path.strip()
+    if stripped.lower().startswith("data:"):
+        return decode_data_image_url(stripped) is not None
+    return extract_storage_key(stripped) is not None
+
+
+def load_image_bytes(url_or_path: str) -> Optional[bytes]:
+    """Load image bytes from a data: image URL or our configured storage service."""
+    if not isinstance(url_or_path, str) or not url_or_path.strip():
+        return None
+    stripped = url_or_path.strip()
+    if stripped.lower().startswith("data:"):
+        return decode_data_image_url(stripped)
+
+    key = extract_storage_key(stripped)
+    if not key:
+        logger.warning("Refused to load image from disallowed URL", url=stripped[:120])
+        return None
+
+    from app.services.storage import storage
+
+    return storage.download_image(key)
+
+
+def load_image_pil(url_or_path: str, mode: Optional[str] = None) -> Optional[Image.Image]:
+    """Load a PIL Image from a data: image URL or our configured storage service."""
+    img_bytes = load_image_bytes(url_or_path)
+    if not img_bytes:
+        return None
+    try:
+        image = Image.open(io.BytesIO(img_bytes))
+        image.load()
+        if mode:
+            return image.convert(mode)
+        return image
+    except Exception as exc:
+        logger.warning("Failed to decode image bytes", error=str(exc))
+        return None

+def test_data_urls_keep_working_everywhere(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    _, episode, cut = _create_project_episode_cut(client, h)
+    data_url = f"data:image/png;base64,{base64.b64encode(PNG).decode()}"
+
+    upd = client.put(f"/api/v1/cuts/{cut['id']}", headers=h, json={"image_path": data_url})
+    assert upd.status_code == 200, upd.text
+    assert upd.json()["image_path"] == data_url
+
+    # ZIP export preserves exact decoded PNG bytes
+    zip_res = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{episode['id']}/export?format=zip", headers=h)
+    assert zip_res.status_code == 200, zip_res.text
+    with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(zip_res.content)) as zf:
+        assert zf.namelist() == ["Ep1_01.png"]
+        assert zf.read("Ep1_01.png") == PNG
+
+    # Webtoon strip export works
+    strip_res = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{episode['id']}/export?format=webtoon", headers=h)
+    assert strip_res.status_code == 200, strip_res.text
+    Image.open(io.BytesIO(strip_res.content)).verify()
+
+    # Scene modify works with data: URL
+    mod_res = client.post(
+        "/api/v1/scenes/modify",
+        headers=h,
+        json={"original_image_url": data_url, "instruction": "Make it night"},
+    )
+    assert mod_res.status_code == 200, mod_res.text
+    assert mod_res.json()["image_url"].startswith("data:image/png;base64,")
+
+    # Reference board works with data: URL
+    boards = create_reference_boards([{"name": "Hero", "image_url": data_url}])
+    assert len(boards) == 1
+    Image.open(io.BytesIO(boards[0])).verify()
